question: Does learned cross-episode key-before-unlock intervention evidence add actual delayed-consequence goal reward over an identical-capacity planner with shuffled affordance relationships, and over fully trained reward Q/recurrent policies, in unseen DoorKey/UnlockPickup MiniGrid environments?
hypothesis: Conditional action-consequence affordance evidence (locked door toggle fails before key, succeeds after key) improves two distinct held-out task families, yielding mean official discounted return at least 0.08 above the strongest preregistered comparator in BOTH DoorKey-8x8 and UnlockPickup, strict per-seed return wins at least 7/12 in each, and preservation of cold goal success after unrelated interference.

predecessor.note: Causal map reached held-out goals but was less reward-efficient than fully trained Q and recurrent controls; MG22 is not post-result tuning. Prior original seeds are never reused.

source_deps.purpose: Official MiniGrid simulator adapter, baseline Q, recurrent, reactive, and map foundation; byte-identical.
Frozen successful-rewarded training predecessor; original code not touched.

input_identity.source_model: official 7x7x3 partial image, public direction, action and physical reward; mission string and hidden agent position, grid and planner information prohibited
input_identity.source_repro: Pin package versions, pip freeze SHA in GitHub Actions; no invented wheel hash

frozen_design.train_seeds: 930001..930024 inclusive in each DoorKey-5x5 and DoorKey-6x6, 48 independent shared physical training episodes
frozen_design.cold_seeds: 950001..950012 DoorKey-6x6 scored once before and after interference, independently charged per agent
frozen_design.transfer_size: 960001..960012 on DoorKey-8x8, once each per agent
frozen_design.transfer_family: 970001..970012 on UnlockPickup, once each per agent
frozen_design.teacher: Fresh cold-start teacher for each training episode, navigating only public partial images/direction and using two real paid interventions where encountered: toggling locked door without key (negative), obtaining key, toggling same door after key (positive), then reaching official task goal. Map/topology planning scaffold is explicitly hand-programmed, not itself learned. Exactly one shared charged teacher trajectory fed to all five models; no per-model training calls to simulator.
frozen_design.candidate: 256-cell bounded online topological memory and public-image-based subgoals. Training records real (door toggle, no key, fails) and (door toggle, key carried, succeeds) physical outcomes, with key carrying inferred from disappearance of visible key after pickup. At >=3 opposite-context direct intervention contrast pairs, prioritize key before locked door on new episodes. No environment hidden fields. Other navigation is deterministic fixed algorithm.
frozen_design.sham: Identical scaffold, module capacity and charged training outcomes, all training counters retained, but temporal relationship between pickup and door outcome is deterministically ignored at subgoal selection (unconditional door-before-key probe); tests value of learned causal ordering rather than effect of mapping alone.
frozen_design.strong_controls: Original fully trainable MG20 12-cell recurrent BPTT imitation learner and tabular Q gamma 0.95, lr .2 trained from identical successful shared teacher episodes; original reactive goal-aware no-memory; no extra actions or hidden information. Q and RNN are not necessarily state-of-the-art; do not claim superiority to all conventional methods.
frozen_design.audit: At each held-out episode, each frozen agent must choose and pay for every actual action; score official reward>0 and discounted official return, steps to goal, per-seed wins, explicit no-key and with-key interventions, proof that learned edge actually triggered vs sham, 64KiB checkpoint cap, exact action/outcome trajectory SHA; audit outcomes never update training weights or persistent memory.
frozen_design.cold_memory: Learnt link and passability persisted across training/interference, ephemeral pose, key, door state and map reset each held-out episode. Exact source/checkpoint snapshots before/after interference and no evaluation training. CPU wall time per OS reported separately.
frozen_design.coverage: At least 24 of 48 teacher training episodes must achieve official goal, and at least 8 distinct charged failed no-key door toggles and 8 successful with-key door toggles in shared training; >=3 official goal successes across five arms in EACH heldout transfer family. Otherwise INVALID_TASK_COVERAGE regardless of candidate returns.
frozen_design.data_split: Three toy-only seeds 11,17,19 for prefirstuse negative controls; registered 930001..970012 appear only on original PR opening event. No learning from test-world outcomes.
frozen_design.repro: Original first use runs once on draft PR opened with exact registered SHA. Linux+Windows full original outcome fields/action SHA/checkpoints equal except explicit runtime timing (numeric <=1e-8, bytes identical for snapshots). Python 3.12, pinned package versions. Source commit and tree pinned; all science artifacts GitHub-only.
frozen_design.capacity: Candidate/sham at most 256 cached coordinate tiles per episode and tiny learned conditional effects, persistent checkpoint <=65536 bytes; RNN 12 hidden state, fixed 8-step BPTT; same fixed source/compute protocol.

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY only if complete valid physical/source/crossOS custody and coverage; candidate official goal success >=8/12 each heldout family and >=best control success -1, mean discounted official return >=best of ALL four controls +0.08 on EACH family, strictly higher actual official return on >=7 of 12 seeds per family vs frozen best-return control; score better than sham by >=0.08 in both; learned key-before-door module activated in >=8/12 episode starts and both recorded contrast event counts >=8; cold-after goal success >= cold-before -1; all checkpoint <=64KiB, candidate CPU <=5x trained recurrent, first-use exact source and no evaluation weight learning. Passing remains external DEV only, not native AGI or official acceptance.
classification_rules.mixed: MIXED_DEV if valid physical and portability coverage but primary false, with candidate >=2 additional official goals vs at least one control on a heldout family, or candidate does >=8/12 official goals in one heldout family and learned intervention link actually activated on >=3 distinct heldout episodes.
classification_rules.negative: NEGATIVE_DEV if valid physical/portability/coverage, primary false and no preregistered partial positive signal.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID_TASK_COVERAGE if teacher <24/48 successful or <8 failure-without-key and <8 success-with-key paid probes, or fewer than 3 heldout actual goal events in one transfer family. INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE/INVALID_REPRO for source/seed/action-budget drift, missing actual env.step, hidden private map/goal/mission leakage, pretrained model reused from earlier registered datasets, mismatched crossOS original action/traces/checkpoint, unverifiable full control weight training, checkpoint corruption, missing cold audit or oracle reward leakage. Valid underperformance is not an infrastructure failure.

post_result_prohibitions: No tuning thresholds, environment split, teacher or navigation rule after original result
No repeats of registered firstuse after original PR opening
No reinterpretation of scripted planner as learned general intelligence
No native or accepted-model promotion on external DEV signal
note: Preregistration-only first commit. External stacked draft PR based on frozen MG21, no parent/native model changes, prior MG20/MG21 first-use explicitly guarded from descendant replay.
